bullets.title: Amazon’s Leadership Principles
bullets.note:
\-- This is a short bullet-point page in the “Jobs” section of Amazon’s
corporate site. Here are a few of the gems I want to explore:  
“As we do new things, we accept that we may be misunderstood for long periods
of time.”  
“They seek diverse perspectives and work to disconfirm their beliefs.”  
“...problems are fixed so they stay fixed.”

bullets.title: THE BIRTH OF SAKÉ
bullets.note:
(documentary). From Amazon: In a world where most mass produced goods are
heavily automated, a small group of artisans must brave tough working
conditions to preserve the ancient tradition that we have come to know as
saké. THE BIRTH OF SAKÉ reveals the story of passionate saké-makers and what
it takes to make world-class saké at Yoshida Brewery, a 144-year-old family-
owned small brewery in northern Japan.

[Skin Against Skin [feat. Deborah
Anderson]](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=dCI&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=N&)
by DJ Krush

bullets.title: Slow-carb dinner
bullets.note:
Caribou tenderloin from sous-vide @ 130 for 60 min w bay leaves, finished w
sear in coconut milk. Sliced and tossed w carmelized onions, garlic, and
brussel sprouts roasted in EVOO at 450 for 25 min (mixed 3x). All tossed w
maldon sea salt, tellicherry pepper, cinnamon, and thyme. Wine is Arcipressi
red from Tuscany.
